title: Mehndiya Waleya Hathan Tey
body:
Mehndiya waleya hathan tey rassiyan pehgaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Sirr sehreyan waala naizey tey agaya tey maawan khaak te behgaiyan…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Yusuf dey malikan da teera baras da yusuf takseem ewein hoya,
Kuj khaak che milleya summa che kuj gaya kuj garm hawawan lehgaiyan…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Qasim di laash tey eh farwa ney vayn keetey kinj maa shagan manawey,
